rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when describing how someone acts in a particular situation or manner.

example.english: They behave very politely in meetings.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺會議入面表現得好有禮貌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 wui6 ji5 jap6 min6 biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this when behaving properly means following rules or accepted standards.

example.english: Children have to behave properly in the library.
example.traditional: 細路仔喺圖書館要守規矩。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 jiu3 sau2 gwai1 geoi2

rows.note: Use this for general conduct, especially how someone conducts themselves socially rather than for one particular act.

example.english: The most important thing in how you behave is being trustworthy.
example.jyutping: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jau5 seon3 jung6
